Gives the address of each link as the page wrote it, beside the resolved address

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.links))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.links, 0).original_url)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.links, 0).url)
```
